blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled made franchise history at the perfect time on Tuesday night. The Chameleons took down defending champion Creamline for the first time, 25-20, 12-25, 25-21, 25-19, and secured the No. 1 seed and a twice-to-beat advantage in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series semifinals on Tuesday night at Philsports Arena.
